title: Picture-in-Picture Video Controls
description: Learn how to use Picture-in-Picture mode to watch videos in a floating window while browsing other content, with full video controls and customization options.
content:
Picture-in-Picture (PiP) mode allows you to watch videos in a floating window that stays on top of other applications and browser tabs. This feature is perfect for multitasking - you can continue browsing, working, or using other applications while keeping an eye on your video content. Modern browsers provide comprehensive video controls and customization options for the PiP window.

Pro Tip

Picture-in-Picture is especially useful for watching tutorials, news, or entertainment content while working on other tasks. The floating window can be resized, moved, and controlled independently of the main browser window.

What is Picture-in-Picture?

Picture-in-Picture (PiP) is a video playback feature that allows you to:

Floating Video Window

  • Watch videos in a separate, floating window
  • Keep the video visible while using other applications
  • Position the window anywhere on your screen
  • Resize the window to your preferred size

Multitasking Benefits

  • Continue browsing while watching videos
  • Work on documents with video in background
  • Monitor live streams while multitasking
  • Keep important content visible at all times

PiP works with most video content on the web, including YouTube, Netflix, Hulu, and other streaming platforms that support HTML5 video.

How to Enable Picture-in-Picture

Method 1: Right-Click Menu

The most common way to enable PiP:

  1. Navigate to a webpage with video content
  2. Right-click on the video player
  3. Select Picture in Picture from the context menu
  4. The video will appear in a floating window

Method 2: Video Controls

Some video players have built-in PiP buttons:

  1. Look for a PiP icon in the video player controls
  2. Click the PiP button to enable Picture-in-Picture
  3. The icon typically looks like a small rectangle or window
  4. This method works on platforms like YouTube and Netflix

Method 3: Keyboard Shortcut

Quick keyboard access to PiP:

  1. Click on the video to ensure it's focused
  2. Press Alt + P (Windows/Linux) or Option + P (macOS)
  3. The video will immediately enter PiP mode
  4. This shortcut works with most HTML5 video players

PiP Window Controls

Once in Picture-in-Picture mode, you have full control over the floating video window:

Basic Video Controls

  • Play/Pause: Click the play button or spacebar
  • Volume: Adjust volume with the slider
  • Seek: Click on the progress bar to jump to different parts
  • Fullscreen: Expand the PiP window to full screen

Window Management

  • Move: Click and drag the window to any position
  • Resize: Drag the corners to change window size
  • Close: Click the X button to exit PiP mode
  • Minimize: Click the minimize button to hide temporarily
Enhanced Control

The PiP window includes all standard video controls, making it easy to pause, adjust volume, or seek through content without returning to the original tab.

Supported Video Platforms

Picture-in-Picture works with most modern video platforms:

Streaming Services

  • YouTube (most videos)
  • Netflix (browser version)
  • Hulu
  • Amazon Prime Video
  • Disney+
  • HBO Max
  • Twitch

Other Content

  • HTML5 video players
  • Educational platforms
  • News websites
  • Social media videos
  • Webinar platforms
  • Video conferencing tools
Compatibility Note

Some platforms may restrict PiP functionality for certain content due to licensing agreements. If PiP doesn't work on a specific video, it may be due to content restrictions.

Customizing PiP Experience

Window Positioning

Optimize your PiP window placement:

  • Corner Placement: Position in corners to minimize interference
  • Screen Edges: Place near screen edges for easy access
  • Overlap Management: Avoid covering important UI elements
  • Multi-Monitor: Move PiP window to secondary displays

Size Optimization

Choose the right size for your needs:

  • Small Size: Minimal distraction, good for background viewing
  • Medium Size: Balanced visibility and screen space
  • Large Size: Better detail, more prominent presence
  • Fullscreen: Maximum immersion when needed

Audio Management

Control audio while using PiP:

  • Volume Control: Adjust PiP volume independently
  • Mute Options: Mute PiP while keeping other audio
  • Audio Focus: PiP audio takes priority when active
  • Background Audio: Continue audio when PiP is minimized

Advanced PiP Features

Multiple PiP Windows

Some browsers support multiple PiP windows:

  • Open multiple videos in separate PiP windows
  • Manage different content simultaneously
  • Organize windows by content type
  • Switch between different PiP sessions

PiP with Extensions

Enhance PiP functionality with extensions:

  • Always-on-top PiP windows
  • Custom PiP window styles
  • PiP for unsupported content
  • Advanced PiP controls and shortcuts

PiP Use Cases

Picture-in-Picture is particularly useful for:

Productivity

  • Watching tutorials while following along
  • Monitoring live streams during work
  • Keeping news or updates visible
  • Video conferencing while multitasking

Entertainment

  • Background music videos
  • Sports events while browsing
  • TV shows during other activities
  • Gaming streams while working

Education

  • Online courses while taking notes
  • Language learning videos
  • Documentary viewing
  • Academic presentations

Communication

  • Video calls while checking email
  • Webinar participation
  • Team meetings with shared content
  • Remote collaboration sessions

Troubleshooting PiP Issues

PiP Not Available

If Picture-in-Picture doesn't work:

  1. Check if the video is HTML5 (not Flash-based)
  2. Ensure the website supports PiP functionality
  3. Try refreshing the page and attempting again
  4. Check browser settings for PiP permissions
  5. Update your browser to the latest version

PiP Window Issues

If the PiP window has problems:

  1. Close and reopen the PiP window
  2. Check for conflicting browser extensions
  3. Restart the browser application
  4. Clear browser cache and cookies
  5. Check system permissions for window management

Audio Problems

If PiP audio doesn't work correctly:

  1. Check system audio settings
  2. Ensure PiP window isn't muted
  3. Verify browser audio permissions
  4. Check for audio conflicts with other applications
  5. Try adjusting volume controls in PiP window

Privacy and Security Considerations

Privacy Benefits

  • PiP windows are isolated from main browser
  • Reduced tracking when using PiP mode
  • Independent audio controls
  • No interference with other browser tabs

Security Features

  • PiP windows respect browser security policies
  • Content restrictions are maintained
  • Safe from cross-site scripting in PiP mode
  • Independent of main browser session

PiP Benefits

Enhanced Multitasking

Picture-in-Picture allows you to watch videos while working on other tasks, maximizing productivity and entertainment value.

Flexible Viewing

The floating window can be positioned anywhere on your screen and resized to fit your preferences and workflow.

Important Note

This guide is based on Mozilla's Picture-in-Picture documentation. For the most up-to-date information and official documentation, please visit the Mozilla Support page.
